notes: Stories defined for travel burden computation using existing clinical_trials_service integration with Google Routes.

stories.title: Travel Info Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define response schema for travel burden including distance (miles/km), duration (minutes), origin, destination, and error states. Align with clinical trial location model.

stories.title: Core Travel Computation Logic
stories.description: Implement or refine _get_travel_info logic to call Google Routes API, compute distance and duration between user location and trial sites, and handle multiple locations per trial.

stories.title: Facade Integration for Trial Results
stories.description: Integrate travel burden computation into evaluate_care_facade so each returned clinical trial includes travel distance and time in the response payload.

stories.title: Error Handling and Fallbacks
stories.description: Implement robust error handling for Google Routes failures, including timeouts, missing coordinates, and API errors. Provide fallback behavior (e.g., omit travel info or return partial data).

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Travel Burden
stories.description: Create tests validating distance and duration calculations, multi-location handling, and error scenarios. Include mocked Google Routes responses and integration coverage via facade.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing tests for travel computation; must be added under backend/tests for clinical trials service

per_feature.mitigation: Cache or reuse computed travel results within request scope to reduce repeated API calls.
